userStories.title: PR body survives a halted rebase (PRD D-11, #269)
userStories.description: spell-commit-work: write the PR body file BEFORE step 9b; step 9b rebases with `git rebase --autostash origin/<target>`; the raw-CLI PR path (9d/9e) refuses to create a PR whose body is empty. spell-create-pull-request: Step 0.6 uses `--autostash`; Step 5 refuses to create a PR whose body file is missing or empty and says to run Step 4 first (covers a resumed flow). git-conventions.md 'Agent-mandatory pre-PR guard' snippet uses --autostash. Keep ARC-023 enforcement annotations accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: new test asserts: commit-work writes the body before 9b; both spells use --autostash; both refuse an empty body; git-conventions guard snippet matches
userStories.testEvidence: test/up02-b-pr-body.test.ts 8/8 pass; 31 related existing test files (697 tests) still pass; check:self-host-parity, check:citations, check:adr-references, check:stale-claims (7 advisory hits, unchanged from baseline) pass; --autostash behaviour verified on git 2.43.0 in a scratch repo

userStories.title: Push-policy check shared by every pushing spell (ARC-049 decision 4, #280)
userStories.description: New ARC-039 fragment src/assets/.arcane/spells/_fragments/push-policy-check.md: read `push_policy` from the repo's .arcane.json before any push. guarded -> state the policy and ask the operator for explicit confirmation before pushing; in an autonomous run with no operator, do not push and report the pending push (fails closed). blocked -> do not attempt the push, say why, name `spell unblock-push` (interactive terminal). open/absent -> proceed. Expand it (fragment markers, then `npm run fix:self-host-parity`) at the push step of spell-commit-work (9a), spell-create-pull-request (Step 0 push/force-with-lease), spell-ship, spell-sync-pull-request, spell-close-session. Do not change frontmatter.
acceptanceCriteria: `npm run check:self-host-parity` passes with the new fragment expanded in all five spells
new test asserts each of the five spells contains the fragment and names both behaviours
userStories.testEvidence: test/up02-b-push-policy.test.ts 30/30 pass (fragment content + per-spell: marker pair, fully expanded, both behaviours, check precedes the push, root copy matches); check:self-host-parity passes with the fragment expanded in all 5 spells (327 items); check:citations, check:adr-references, check:stale-claims (7 advisory hits, baseline) and npm run build pass; 33 related existing test files still pass
